en: A vintage black-and-white postcard view showing a small passenger boat or ferry sailing on a body of water in front of a tree‑lined shore with several large buildings. One prominent domed church-like structure with a lantern tower stands on the hill, and to the right there is a large, ornate building with towers. The upper left corner of the card bears printed text in Swedish describing the view of Skeppsholmen in Stockholm.
